project.objective: Identify the parents of John Richardson (bapt. 1833, Ashton-under-Lyne, Lancashire, England) from the parish registers

questions.question: Who were the parents of John Richardson, baptised 1833 at Ashton-under-Lyne, Lancashire?
questions.rationale: Primary research objective. The tree records a baptism year but no parents. Richardson is one of the commonest surnames in the parish, so an indexed name search is expected to return many same-named candidates; the parish register itself is the authority.

items.rationale: The baptism register for the parish should name both parents. A common surname means the register has to be worked as a register, not sampled by one name query.
